summary.text: Joe Baldacci, a Democrat, represents Maine Senate District 9, which covers Bangor and Hermon in Penobscot County. The Maine Legislature's profile lists committee assignments to Inland Fisheries and Wildlife (Chair), State and Local Government (Chair) and Health Coverage, Insurance, and Financial Services.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists legislative service as Senate 130-132.
